slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: The essay's country table states that in rural Kenya births are registered on paper Form B1 in duplicate by assistant chiefs at sub-locations (10,666 in all) or at rural health facilities, the duplicates batched to Civil Registration Offices for entry into registers, and that sub-county registrars send Excel summaries of the paper registers to the national office; it gives no date for this, so the published date is used.
facts.system: paper Form B1 and registers at Civil Registration Offices

systems.system: paper Form B1 and registers at Civil Registration Offices
systems.tiers: assistant chiefs at sub-locations and rural health facilities notify on paper; sub-county registrars enter registers and send Excel summaries to the national office
piloted in some counties, not scaled for want of resources
